added.title: Cartoon
added.prompt:
Transform this image
into a mixed live-action and cartoon scene inspired by classic Hollywood animation like Who
Framed Roger Rabbit
Keep the original photograph realistic, including lighting, textures, and environment.
Add hand-drawn 2D cartoon characters and animated elements interacting directly with the real objects in the scene.
Cartoon characters should touch, lean on, or react to real-world objects in the photo - for example: • pulling something • pushing objects • hanging from items • popping out from behind real objects
• reacting with exaggerated cartoon expressions
Add playful animation effects like motion lines, comic stars, sparkles, squash-and-stretch motion, and exaggerated cartoon physics.
Some real objects should slightly deform or react as if affected by cartoon energy - bending, bouncing, or stretching in a humorous animated way.
Use bold hand-drawn outlines, vibrant cartoon colors, and classic 2D animation shading.
The cartoon elements should cast subtle shadows and integrate with the scene lighting so they feel like they exist inside the real photo.
Overall style: Live-action world mixed with energetic vintage cartoon animation, playful, chaotic, expressive, cinematic composition.
High detail, professional mixed-media look, vibrant and dynamic.
cartoon characters leaving ink splashes, paint streaks, and animated smoke trails as they move
